decision.explanation: The question asks for the consul election year of 'Lucius Calpurnius Piso Caesoninus'. Multiple sources (D1S1, D1S2, D2S1-D2S12, D3S1-D3S2) explicitly identify the subject as the individual who was consul in 112 BC. Source D4S1-D4S2 describes a different individual, 'Lucius Calpurnius Piso Caesoninus (consul 148 BC)', who is the father/grandfather of the subject in question. The 148 BC date refers to the ancestor, not the specific person whose biography details the 112 BC consulship and death in 107 BC. Therefore, 148 BC is an incorrect answer for the specific referent implied by the majority of the text describing the 112 BC consul. Only 112 BC is the correct year for the primary subject described in the detailed biographical segments.
